objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: the reverse-parity of two equal halves forces the combined \(D(Q)\) to be even with respect to the unit lattice generated by the lowest dyadic, ultimately giving \(D(Q)\le D(P)-1\) or \(D(Q)\ge D(P)+1\)
objection.witness: The other lower-bound subcase invokes an unproved dyadic lattice dichotomy, although cut locations are arbitrary real numbers. Reverse triangle alone cannot show the union has D at least 1.
